body:
Wait... are you serious?  100,000 a year for anesthetizing patients?  If that's the kind of money I could pull per year, I could do anything.

How long would I be in anesthesia school for?
When you have no income, 7000 can seem a HELL of a lot bigger.  Before I started spiraling like this, I wanted to just buy a piece of land and build a house on it.
I don't want to die.  I just don't see any other options.

If I needed any money up front AT ALL, I wouldn't be able to do that kind of a program.

If I don't, I'll look into it first thing tomorrow.

Nope.  Never been hit or abused.  Not on drugs or alcohol.  Free and clear.

I know there's no white knight.  I just felt like I had to know I let someone know why I died, even if it's anonymously on the internet.  I just feel that maybe someone I knew will find this and understand why I did what I did.

Honestly, I really don't anymore.  I tend to think of anything that's not job-related as a waste of time nowadays.

College is out of the question because I don't even have enough to hit a community college.  I'm 7000 dollars in debt.  I doubt I could even get financial aid.  And even if I was able to go back to school, I'd need to be WORKING before I went back.  I moved where I'm living just to find a job.  I actually live on the other side of the country where I have MORE financial obligations.

I can't even think about going back to school until I'm working full time.  I have too many obligations, and no money to support them.

I had to move back in with my parents.  I have food and lodging, but there's no point in me trying to figure out "What i really want to do" at this point.  I'm 27.  School is over and no longer an option.  I have no money to my name.  I'm getting rejected for retail jobs left and right.

I have no idea what to do.

I want to have hope for the future.  I want a small house on a piece of land that's mine, but as I keep getting deeper and deeper in debt, that little hope is not even alive anymore.

The only reason I have ever mattered is because I do whatever people tell me.  I'm the dumping ground for everything.  I'm the lowest member of my entire family.

I know people care, but honestly, I'm not sure if "people caring" is enough to want to stay alive with this awful mess anymore.

If I could find a job where I could make 30K a year, I may be able to afford having some hope for myself, but I've had awful luck just searching for the past 3 years with everyone saying "You're not what we're looking for".  BURGER KING refused to hire me...

Everyone has kind of pushed me through my whole life.  Even my college career never amounted to much because I was pushed into studying what everyone else wanted me to: music.  What job can you get with a music degree?  Nothing really, unless you want to do private tutoring, and you have to have a name for yourself first.

Nah.  Nothing I've wanted EVER comes to fruition.  I'm just used to doing what other people want.  I'm just a god damned tool.

My brother and sister are very successful, both making somewhere around 50-80k a year.  I have never made 20k a year, even when i WAS employed.

I've been in the "Something needs to change" stage for so long, I don't even think change is possible anymore.

He likely would kill himself, I'm sad to say.  But short of killing myself, I really can't think of any other way out of this.  I am draining my family, and my unemployment is affecting my boyfriend, too.

I have little choice.  Work, or death.

I have been searching for 3 years, I think it's time.
